#include <cassert>
#include <chrono>

using namespace std;
using namespace __gnu_pbds;

auto get_random_address = [] { char *p = new char; delete p; return (uint64_t) p; };

struct custom_hash {
    static uint64_t splitmix64(uint64_t x) {
        x += 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15;
        x = (x ^ (x >> 30)) * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9;
        x = (x ^ (x >> 27)) * 0x94d049bb133111eb;
        return x ^ (x >> 31);
    }

    uint64_t operator()(uint64_t x) const {
        static const uint64_t seed = splitmix64(chrono::steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch().count() * (get_random_address() | 1));
        return splitmix64(x ^ seed);
    }
};

const int MOD_CONST = 1e9 + 7;

struct modular {
    int value;

    modular(long long v = 0) {
        if (v < 0) v = v % MOD_CONST + MOD_CONST;
        if (v >= MOD_CONST) v %= MOD_CONST;
        value = v;
    }

    static int extended_gcd(int a, int m, int &x, int &y) {
        if (m == 0) {
            x = 1; y = 0;
            return a;
        }
        int g = extended_gcd(m, a % m, y, x);
        y -= (a / m) * x;
        return g;
    }

    static int modular_inverse(int a, int m = MOD_CONST) {
        int x, y;
        extended_gcd(a, m, x, y);
        return (x % m + m) % m;
    }

    explicit operator int() const { return value; }

    modular& operator+=(const modular &other) {
        value += other.value;
        if (value >= MOD_CONST) value -= MOD_CONST;
        return *this;
    }

    modular& operator-=(const modular &other) {
        value -= other.value;
        if (value < 0) value += MOD_CONST;
        return *this;
    }

    static unsigned fast_mod(uint64_t x, unsigned m = MOD_CONST) {
#if !defined(_WIN32) || defined(_WIN64)
        return x % m;
#endif
        unsigned high = x >> 32, low = (unsigned) x;
        unsigned q, r;
        asm("divl %4\n"
            : "=a" (q), "=d" (r)
            : "d" (high), "a" (low), "r" (m));
        return r;
    }

    modular& operator*=(const modular &other) {
        value = fast_mod((uint64_t) value * other.value);
        return *this;
    }

    modular& operator/=(const modular &other) {
        return *this *= modular::inverse(other.value);
    }

    friend modular operator+(const modular &a, const modular &b) { return modular(a) += b; }
    friend modular operator-(const modular &a, const modular &b) { return modular(a) -= b; }
    friend modular operator*(const modular &a, const modular &b) { return modular(a) *= b; }
    friend modular operator/(const modular &a, const modular &b) { return modular(a) /= b; }

    modular& operator++() {
        value = (value == MOD_CONST - 1) ? 0 : value + 1;
        return *this;
    }

    modular& operator--() {
        value = (value == 0) ? MOD_CONST - 1 : value - 1;
        return *this;
    }

    modular operator++(int) { modular tmp = *this; ++(*this); return tmp; }
    modular operator--(int) { modular tmp = *this; --(*this); return tmp; }

    modular operator-() const {
        return value == 0 ? 0 : MOD_CONST - value;
    }

    bool operator==(const modular &other) const { return value == other.value; }
    bool operator!=(const modular &other) const { return value != other.value; }

    static modular inverse(int a) {
        return modular(modular::mod_inv(a));
    }

    modular pow(long long p) const {
        assert(p >= 0);
        modular base = *this, result = 1;
        while (p > 0) {
            if (p & 1) result *= base;
            base *= base;
            p >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }
};

const int MAX_N = 10;
int size_N;
modular prob_matrix[MAX_N][MAX_N];

int main() {
    cin >> size_N;
    for (int i = 0; i < size_N; i++)
        for (int j = 0; j < size_N; j++) {
            int p;
            cin >> p;
            prob_matrix[i][j] = modular(p) / modular(100);
        }

    vector<vector<int>> count_masks(size_N + 1);
    vector<int> lookup_mask(1 << size_N, -1);
    for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << size_N); ++mask) {
        int c = __builtin_popcount(mask);
        lookup_mask[mask] = count_masks[c].size();
        count_masks[c].push_back(mask);
    }

    gp_hash_table<long long, modular, custom_hash> possible_states;
    possible_states[1LL << lookup_mask[0]] = 1;

    for (int left = 0; left < size_N; ++left) {
        gp_hash_table<long long, modular, custom_hash> new_states;
        vector<modular> product_mask(1 << size_N, 1);
        for (int current_mask = 0; current_mask < (1 << size_N); ++current_mask) {
            for (int right = 0; right < size_N; ++right) {
                product_mask[current_mask] *= (current_mask >> right & 1) ? prob_matrix[left][right] : modular(1) - prob_matrix[left][right];
            }
        }
        vector<long long> new_bits(size_N, 0);
        vector<modular> new_possible(1 << size_N, 0);
        for (auto &state : possible_states) {
            long long mask_state = state.first;
            modular prob_value = state.second;
            fill(new_bits.begin(), new_bits.end(), 0);
            for (int mask : count_masks[left]) {
                if (mask_state >> lookup_mask[mask] & 1) {
                    for (int i = 0; i < size_N; ++i) {
                        if ((mask >> i & 1) == 0) {
                            new_bits[i] |= 1LL << lookup_mask[mask | 1 << i];
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            fill(new_possible.begin(), new_possible.end(), 0);
            for (int current_mask = 1; current_mask < (1 << size_N); ++current_mask) {
                new_possible[current_mask] = new_possible[current_mask & (current_mask - 1)] | new_bits[__builtin_ctz(current_mask)];
                new_states[new_possible[current_mask]] += prob_value * product_mask[current_mask];
            }
        }
        possible_states = move(new_states);
    }

    modular answer = 0;
    for (auto &state : possible_states) {
        if (state.first >> lookup_mask[(1 << size_N) - 1] & 1)
            answer += state.second;
    }
    cout << (int)answer << '\n';
}
